ja: カギが　かかっている
ベリルシャッター解除

key: TITANIA: So the whole city should be running clean now.
en: TITANIA: So the whole city should be running clean now.
ja: ティタニア: これで街全体がきれいな水になったはずね。
アマリアも誇りに思ってくれるはず。

key: Now let's make sure she wakes up to see it.
en: Now let's make sure she wakes up to see it.
ja: あとは彼女が目を覚まして、それを見られるようにしないと。

key: You can't see it from where you are, but one of the gates in the back of this room just turned on.
en: You can't see it from where you are, but one of the gates in the back of this room just turned on.
ja: そこからじゃ見えないでしょうけど、この部屋の奥のゲートの一つが、今、動き出したの。

key: There's a line of them. I'm guessing each one corresponds to a room in this facility.
en: There's a line of them. I'm guessing each one corresponds to a room in this facility.
ja: ずらっと並んでるの。多分、それぞれこの施設の各部屋に対応してるんだと思う。

key: Once the water is clear, they activate.
en: Once the water is clear, they activate.
ja: 水がきれいになると、起動する仕組みみたい。

key: When those are open, I should be able to get out of here.
en: When those are open, I should be able to get out of here.
ja: あれが全部開けば、あたしもここから出られるはずよ。

key: So looks like it's up to you, kid.
en: So looks like it's up to you, kid.
ja: だから、あんた次第ってわけね、坊や。
